signals.summary: Feeds are turning from summer produce toward cozy autumn cooking — fall soups, slow-cooker meals and warm seasonal plates as the late-August seasonal shift begins.
signals.why_now: Country Living's '8 Late-Summer Dinners to Make Before the Seasons Change' (~16h) alongside Sunset's 'Say Goodbye to Summer and Welcome Fall' (~51h), The Everygirl's 24 fall crockpot recipes and Allrecipes' '17 Lazy Fall Soups' — the annual late-August turn to warm plates across four independent outlets.

signals.summary: Peak-season tomatoes, sweet corn and stone fruit dominate recipe feeds — salads, gazpachos and simple produce-forward plates that photograph beautifully.
signals.why_now: Simply Recipes' '27 Tomato Recipes I'm Making All Summer', Allrecipes' August cucumber-tomato salad, Hudson Valley's green-tomato gazpacho (~189h, seasonal) and Food & Wine's tomato-and-sweet-corn salad roundup — a produce wave squarely on-season.

signals.summary: Grill-forward, game-day food as the football season opens — tailgate boards, grass-fed beef and skewers at the tail end of summer.
signals.why_now: Pre Brands' grass-fed 'kicks off football season' tailgating recipe push (~47h) and Bon Appetit's skewer-grilling video (~45h) as NFL/college kickoff arrives; classic late-August grill-and-game-day cooking.

signals.summary: Sweet-meets-savoury flavour mashups are being named as a 2026 wave — sweetcorn desserts and other 'swavoury' hybrids that read as novel but stay photogenic.
signals.why_now: BBC's 'Why sweetcorn treats are the latest swavoury UK food trend' (~12h) landing on top of 2026 flavour-forecast coverage ('newstalgia to swangy'); still thin on independent corroboration this cycle.
